<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/quote-split.ts -->
<!--
  Testimonials in a split or with figures. Axes: layout (media: one quote card and an action beside a picture,
  logos: one quote over four logo tiles beside a picture, rating: one quote beside a rating panel, stack: three
  stacked quote cards beside a picture, compact: four short quote cards in a row, bento: figures over a featured
  quote beside a stack), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { QuoteExtras } from "./quote-split.types";
  import type { Quote, QuoteLabels } from "./testimonial-grid.types";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
  import type { Logo } from "./logo-cloud.types";
  import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

  export type QuoteSplitProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    quotes: Quote[];
    labels: QuoteLabels;
    extras: QuoteExtras;
    actions: LinkActions;
    layout?: "media" | "logos" | "rating" | "stack" | "compact" | "bento";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import QuoteFigures from "../components/quote-figures.svelte";
  import QuoteLogoTiles from "../components/quote-logo-tiles.svelte";
  import QuoteRatingPanel from "../components/quote-rating-panel.svelte";
  import QuoteSlot from "../components/quote-slot.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    quotes,
    labels,
    extras,
    actions,
    layout = "media",
    mediaSide = "end",
    tone = "default",
  }: QuoteSplitProps = $props();
</script>

{#if (((layout as string) === "compact") || ((layout as string) === "bento"))}
  <SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} heading={{ badge }} tone={tone} density="default">
    {#if ((layout as string) === "bento")}
      <QuoteFigures extras={extras} />
    {/if}
    <Box
      class={
        (layout as string) === "bento" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2"
        : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4"
      }
    >
      {#each quotes as q, i (q.id)}
        <QuoteSlot
          q={q}
          labels={labels}
          kind="card"
          layout={((((layout as string) === "bento") && (i === 0)) ? "single" : "grid")}
          class={((((layout as string) === "bento") && (i === 0)) ? "lg:row-span-3" : "")}
        />
      {/each}
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge }}
    tone={tone}
    density="default"
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
  >
    {#if (((layout as string) === "media") || ((layout as string) === "logos") || ((layout as string) === "rating"))}
      {#each quotes as q, i (q.id)}
        {#if (i < 1)}
          <QuoteSlot
            q={q}
            labels={labels}
            kind={(((layout as string) === "media") ? "card" : "plain")}
            layout="single"
            class=""
          />
        {/if}
      {/each}
    {/if}
    {#if ((layout as string) === "logos")}
      <QuoteLogoTiles extras={extras} />
    {/if}
    {#if ((layout as string) === "stack")}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
        {#each quotes as q, i (q.id)}
          {#if (i < 3)}
            <QuoteSlot q={q} labels={labels} kind="card" layout="stack" class="" />
          {/if}
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    {/if}
    {#if (((layout as string) === "media") || ((layout as string) === "logos") || ((layout as string) === "rating"))}
      <ActionGroup
        primary={actions.cta}
        primaryHref={actions.href}
        secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
        secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
        align="start"
      />
    {/if}
    {#snippet aside()}
      {#if ((layout as string) === "rating")}
        <QuoteRatingPanel extras={extras} labels={labels} />
      {:else}
        <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
      {/if}
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
